# sofascore_scraper.store.RebuildReport
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/indexer.py
@dataclass
class RebuildReport:
    mode: str
    reason: Optional[str]
    completed: bool = False
    events: int = 0
    events_v3: int = 0
    events_legacy: int = 0
    slices: int = 0
    counts: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    problems: List[IndexProblem] = field(default_factory=list)
    superseded: List[SupersededDir] = field(default_factory=list)
    seconds: float = 0.0
    season_lists: int = 0
    schedules: int = 0
    listed: int = 0
    changes: int = 0
    superseded_files: List[LegacySuperseded] = field(default_factory=list)
